content: अतिक्रान्त {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Exceeded, surpassed, gone beyond <ab>&c.</ab>; सोतिक्रान्तः श्रवणविषयम् <ls>Me. 103</ls>; सुदूरमतिक्रान्तः <ls>K. 35</ls> departed, gone; मनोरथ ˚दर्शना <ls>Māl. 10</ls> beyond the reach even of desire; विचारातिक्रान्तः <ls>Mu. 5. 4</ls> past the stage of thought; चक्षुर्विषयातिक्रान्तेषु पक्षिषु <ls>H. 1</ls>. .²2 Past, gone by; ˚कुनृपति <ls>K. 5</ls>, past, former; <ls n="K.">169</ls>; <ls>Pt. 1. 333</ls>; <ls>Pt. 2</ls>, <ls>Bh. 3. 32</ls>; ˚पार्थिवगुणान् <ls>Mu. 1</ls> former kings. .{@-तम्@} A past thing, thing of the past, the past; ˚तं भगवती कथयति <ls>M. 5</ls> your ladyship is speaking of the past; ˚ते धैर्यमवलम्ब्यताम् <ls>U. 3</ls>; किं ˚उपालम्भेन <ls>H. 1</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> ‘let bygones be bygones’ ˚योगिन् {%a.%} with the moon in conjunction.
